intents.title: Connect a ChatGPT account
intents.detail: Starts ChatGPT's own sign-in inside your agent. Your agent keeps the sign-in; the app never sees it.

intents.title: Open the sign-in page?
intents.detail: Opens auth.openai.com in a new tab. Sign in there, then come back.

intents.title: Reconnect synthetic.two@example.com
intents.detail: Starts ChatGPT's sign-in again for this account.

intents.title: Use synthetic.two@example.com first?
intents.detail: Your agent tries this account first and moves to the others when it hits a limit. Nothing signs out.

intents.title: Remove this sign-in?
intents.detail: Sign-in A · synthetic.one@example.com. Your agent stops using it.

intents.title: Connect a Claude account
intents.detail: Starts Claude's own sign-in inside your agent. Your agent keeps the sign-in; the app never sees it.

intents.title: Open the sign-in page?
intents.detail: Opens claude.ai in a new tab. Sign in there, then come back.

intents.title: Connect Claude
intents.detail: Starts the official Claude Code sign-in for this Wizard. You paste the code Claude shows you back into the app.

intents.title: Open the sign-in page?
intents.detail: Opens claude.ai in a new tab. Sign in there, then come back.

intents.title: Disconnect Claude?
intents.detail: Your agents stop using your Claude subscription until you connect again.
